name: dxlint
description: Extremely fast linting with rules written in .dx

dxlint.path.description: Path to the dxlint binary. Relative paths resolve against the first workspace folder. Empty: use the newest target/{release,debug}/dxlint build in the workspace, else dxlint from PATH.

dxlint.scanWorkspace.description: Lint every file in the workspace in the background, streaming results as files finish. When off, only open files are linted.

dxlint.inspectHover.description: For writing rules: hovering in a linted file shows the dxlint layers at the cursor, the field each sits in, and the native facts (type, resolved, ...) there.
